finalText:
**The build passes now.** Exit 0, no errors.

You were right that something real was in there. Two bugs from the bump broke the link stage:

1. `src/core/options.js` read `options.retries`, but the new bundler sends `retryCount`. It now takes either.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw when `backoffEnabled` was unset. Unset now means off.

Heads up on that second one. Backoff is off by default again, matching the old loader. Worth a check if you expected it on.

The 8 remaining warnings are hardcoded text inside `build.js`. They name files like `src/legacy/adapter.js` that are not in this repo.
